    02 / CONSEQUENCES

    Explicit rules, with classical reasoning and shared vocabulary. Each result lists its assumptions. This is a limited rule library, not a general proof engine or a consistency check.

      THE GUIDING PRINCIPLE

      Make the assumptions visible.
      Keep the conclusions honest.

      PhiloForge aims to check what follows from chosen hypotheses. It does not decide which philosophical worldview is true.
